description:
Ready-made broker relay over Spring Cloud Stream
        (ADR-0032): a StreamOutboxPublisher facade stores messages
        (binding, key, headers, payload) in the outbox inside the
        caller's transaction, and a built-in EventHandler delivers
        them to the broker through StreamBridge — no per-project
        event DTO or handler required. Auto-activates when
        StreamBridge is on the classpath; opt out with
        event-outboxer.relay.stream.enabled=false.
